mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_status (user_id, status, status_message, last_seen, last_heartbeat, status_updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{status}, #{statusMessage}, #{lastSeen}, #{lastHeartbeat}, #{statusUpdatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), status_message = VALUES(status_message), last_seen = VALUES(last_seen), last_heartbeat = VALUES(last_heartbeat), status_updated_at = VALUES(status_updated_at)
mapper.update: INSERT INTO user_status (user_id, status, last_heartbeat, status_updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, 'ONLINE', #{heartbeatTime}, #{heartbeatTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_heartbeat = VALUES(last_heartbeat), status = 'ONLINE', status_updated_at = VALUES(status_updated_at)

INSERT INTO user_status (user_id, status, status_message, status_updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{status}, #{statusMessage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), status_message = VALUES(status_message), status_updated_at = VALUES(status_updated_at)

INSERT INTO user_status (user_id, last_seen, status_updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{lastSeen}, #{lastSeen}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_seen = VALUES(last_seen), status_updated_at = VALUES(status_updated_at)
UPDATE user_status SET status = 'OFFLINE', status_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE last_heartbeat < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) AND status != 'OFFLINE'
